goal: By Day 180, Atlas should be able to decide whether to proceed to a pilot operating agreement, staged production, further feasibility upgrade, industrial plant development discussion, or hold/redesign.

phases.title: Data Consolidation & Assumption Control
phases.objective: Convert all existing documents into a structured digital evidence base.
activities: Classify claims and define investor disclosure levels
phases.decisionGate: Data control confirmed — registers complete and contradictions logged.
phases.responsibleLayer: Intelligent Validation System / Atlas internal team
phases.evidenceRequired: Source documents, A.I.P.S study, AFRILAB reports, license documents.

phases.title: Target Mapping & Sampling Upgrade
phases.objective: Upgrade the exploration evidence and define priority copper targets.
phases.decisionGate: Priority targets approved for survey and sampling.
phases.evidenceRequired: Field maps, trench/sample register, GIS layers.

phases.title: Geophysics & Geochemistry Validation
phases.objective: Validate targets through geophysics and multi-element geochemistry.
phases.decisionGate: Geophysics plan executed and targets refined for drilling.
phases.evidenceRequired: Survey data, multi-element assays, QA/QC controls.

phases.title: Pilot Feed Definition
phases.objective: Define what material can be used for pilot testing.
activities: Classify ore by type and grade
phases.decisionGate: Pilot feed defined and approved for metallurgical testing.

phases.title: Process, Water, Power & CAPEX Review
phases.objective: Review the A.I.P.S processing and infrastructure assumptions.
activities: Compare 800 t/day plant with modular pilot
Update water balance and borehole assumptions
Review tailings concept and ONEE power connection
outputs: Pilot vs Full Plant Decision Memo
phases.decisionGate: Engineering review memos approved; CAPEX framework updated.
phases.evidenceRequired: Metallurgical results, water study, power study, current costs.

phases.title: Commercial Decision & Operating Pathway
phases.objective: Convert technical validation into a commercial decision.
activities: Update study findings and correct assumptions
Prepare Atlas board memo and update data room
phases.decisionGate: Commercial decision: pilot, staged production, further validation, or hold/redesign.
phases.evidenceRequired: Validated technical pack, corrected assumptions, updated CAPEX.
